To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the use of personal protective devices is essential in the prevention of COVID 19 transmission in the operating room; 2) the use of a face mask, eye protection, and a surgical gown are essential; 3) a surgical mask and eye protection are sufficient in most clinical settings; and 4) the use of N95 respirators should be limited to aerosol generating procedures and should be reserved for those who are at high risk of exposure to the virus.
